Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Rare
Mythical Instigation
Delirium Tablet
--------
Item Level: 80
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds a Mirror of Delirium to a Map
10 uses remaining
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Elevated" (Tier: 1) }
18(12-18)% increased Experience gain in Map
{ Prefix Modifier "Crystallised" (Tier: 1) }
Map contains an additional Essence — Unscalable Value
{ Suffix Modifier "of Eternity" (Tier: 1) }
Delirium Fog in Map lasts 10(6-12) additional seconds before dissipating
{ Suffix Modifier "of Phobia" (Tier: 1) }
Delirium Encounters in Map are 25(15-30)% more likely to spawn Unique Bosses
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
